content_of_post_to_comment:
My first observation was here.

So, i turned off all history from YouTube and haven't watched any videos for a week except the ones i am subscribed to.

My second observation was that when i watched the videos i am subscribed to, i noticed that my attention span was way longer.
comment: I noticed something similar when I stopped letting recommendation feeds decide what I watched. Having to choose a video intentionally seems to put my brain in a different mode instead of constantly waiting for the next thing to appear. It makes me wonder how much of the attention problem is the content itself versus the endless browsing loop around it.
